Charisma Bard Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level B1, B2
Mass Suggestion: Has increased Suggestion effects
Simple Somatics: Suffers no arcane spell failure risk from wearing light armor
Arcane Bond (Bard): May cast known spell through object
Brew Potion: Can create potions for known, targeted spells of up to 3rd level
Craft Staff: Can create magic staves
Craft Wand: Can create wands for known spells of up to 4th level
Dweomercraft: May use Bardic Performance to give allies +4 caster level checks, concentration, and spell attack
Expanded Repertoire: Knows 5 additional spells taken from any arcane class
Extended Performance: May expend a spell slot to extend Bardic Performance effects 1 rd/spell level
Improved Counterspell: Can counterspell using a higher-level spell from the same school
Metamagic Mastery (Bard): May end Bardic Performance to apply metamagic feat to spell w/out extending casting time
Soothing Performance: R30' Can use a 4 rd Bardic Performance to invoke Mass Cure Serious Wounds effects; also removes fatigued, sickened, and shaken
Spell Suppression: May use Bardic Performance to counter Spellcraft-identified spell of level equal to or less than performance rds
Suggestion: Can use Suggestion effects on fascinated creatures
Wand Mastery: Uses Charisma bonus to calculate save DC and caster level to calculate effects of spells cast from wands
